args.query: MATCH (p1:Player {id: 103819})-[:BEAT]->(p2:Player {id: 104745}), (m:Match)-[:PART_OF]->(t:Tournament {name: 'Wimbledon', year: 2019}) WHERE (p1)-[:BEAT]->(m) AND (p2)-[:LOST]->(m) RETURN m.id AS match_id

MATCH (p1:Player {id: 103819})-[:BEAT]->(p2:Player {id: 104745}), (m:Match)-[:PART_OF]->(t:Tournament {name: 'Wimbledon', year: 2019}) WHERE (p1)-[:BEAT]->(m) AND (p2)-[:LOST]->(m) AND m.round = 'SF' RETURN m.id AS match_id, m.date AS date

MATCH (m:Match)-[:PART_OF]->(t:Tournament {name: 'Wimbledon', year: 2019}) WHERE m.round = 'SF' AND ( (m)-[:PLAYED_BY]->(:Player {id: 103819}) ) AND ( (m)-[:PLAYED_BY]->(:Player {id: 104745}) ) RETURN m.id AS match_id, m.date AS date

MATCH (f:Player {id: 103819})-[:WON]->(m:Match)<-[:LOST]-(n:Player {id: 104745}), (m)-[:PART_OF]->(t:Tournament {name: 'Wimbledon', year: 2019}) WHERE m.round = 'SF' RETURN m.id AS match_id, m.date AS date
